file_contract: Final TRACE.json is an array of trace records keyed by trace_id; redact secrets before writing. Preserve raw process stdout/stderr separately under logs/.

required_fields.actual_outcome: string; S2 M2-01 must remain NOT_IMPLEMENTED
required_fields.request: object with method/path or MCP tool name/allowlisted arguments; never include Authorization or token values
required_fields.response: object with HTTP status and redacted payload summary or MCP result/error summary
required_fields.scope_binding: tenant/task/service/integration/principal/route IDs as applicable; show trusted source and avoid hidden-tenant existence disclosure
required_fields.authn_event: event id, request_id, result_code, credential_policy_version when available, observed_at or null
required_fields.authz_decision: decision id, request_id, outcome, reason_code, tenant/principal/service/integration/route, scope_policy_version, grant_version, required/granted/missing scopes, resource_binding_valid, currentness; null when authn failed
required_fields.mcp_calls: ordered list of tools/list and tools/call with tool schema digest, redacted arguments, status, error code, result digest, source and scope; no free URL/token fields
required_fields.evidence: source IDs/digests, trust class, observed versions, source timestamp, completeness and validity
required_fields.scope_write_audit: setup write count, runtime INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE count, before/after grant and requirement versions
required_fields.receipt_integrity: enum from Rubric; no receipt may be invented for M2-01
required_fields.secret_scan: PASS|FAIL with scanned file set and no secret values
required_fields.real_browser_runs: integer; expected 0 for this backend facts task

sensitive_data_policy: Never write Authorization headers, bearer tokens, credential secret values, passwords, session cookies, CSRF values, or model provider keys.
IDs, HTTP status, redacted order fields, decision/event IDs, versions, reason codes and canonical digests are allowed.
For a hidden/cross-tenant resource, record only the caller-visible non-enumerating response and a test assertion; do not serialize hidden tenant details into external traces.
